rules: 1 all-in crypto pick per day, 100% deployed
Spot crypto only (BTC, ETH, SOL, and other liquid coins on Robinhood)
Rotate each 6:45am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Hard stop at entry; leverage conviction, protect downside

positions.name: Ethereum
positions.catalyst: ETH is the clear beneficiary of an accelerating BTC->altcoin ETF rotation. Bitcoin spot ETFs shed ~3,170 BTC (~$200M) over the 7 days to Jul 28 while Ethereum ETFs extended a 3rd straight week of NET inflows (~37,959 ETH / ~$71M). On Jul 29 Morgan Stanley launched low-cost (0.14%) spot ETH and SOL ETPs WITH staking on NYSE Arca (MSSE/MSOL), a fresh structural demand channel, and the Clarity Act push adds regulatory tailwind. ETH held its bid at ~$1,921 (asOf 2026-07-30T11:52Z) while the broad tape stayed soft — visible relative strength.
positions.driver: Closed prior ETH at 1921.41 (canonical live proxy, asOf 2026-07-30T11:52:49Z) for +$47.03 (entry 1912.95). Re-entered ETH as the best risk-adjusted next-24h setup on a low-edge, cautious tape (declining volume, market cap -0.1%/24h). Per strategy, low-edge days favor liquid majors: ETH pairs a durable, Fed-independent demand driver (3-week ETF inflow streak + new Morgan Stanley staking ETP) with the clearest relative strength as the rotation-out-of-BTC beneficiary. Wins vs runners-up: SOL (~74.13) has the freshest single catalyst (MSOL launch, Solflare bridge) but is higher-beta and testing local support in a weak tape — more downside risk; BTC (~64,734) is bleeding ETF flows with no fresh catalyst. ETH's asymmetric payoff on a tight 8% major stop beats a higher-beta alt on a cautious day.
positions.risks: Broad crypto sentiment is weak with declining conviction/volume; a risk-off leg or a reversal in the ETH ETF inflow streak would pressure price. ETF-rotation narrative can unwind quickly if BTC dominance reasserts. A decisive break below ~$1,860 would signal the momentum bid is failing. Hard stop 1767.70 (-8%) caps downside while leaving room below near-term support.
